faq.q: Are my files uploaded to your servers to merge?
faq.a: No. CoolTools processes all document actions client-side. The file merger runs inside browser memory using the pdf-lib binary engine, protecting your secure information.

faq.q: What is the maximum file size or quantity limit?
faq.a: Because calculations occur inside local browser memory, we recommend merging up to 15 files of under 20MB each to prevent browser tab crashes.
